import novamind_api as nm
# Wk54 actual = d365-371: day%30 in {5..11}; churn end_day in (364,371]
BDM = "(5,6,7,8,9,10,11)"
E0, E1 = 364, 371
A_PRE, C_PRE = 1373, 10882  # pre-bill counts from wk53 forecast slice k=1 (start<330)
print("== WK54 (d365-371) BILLING FLOWS, old core start<330 ==")
res = {}
for plan in ('A','C'):
    st = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day<330 AND plan='{plan}' AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    ch = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'
      AND end_day>{E0} AND end_day<={E1} AND start_day<330 AND plan='{plan}' AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    res[plan] = (st, ch)
    print(f"  plan {plan}: now-subscribed={st} churned-in-window={ch}")
stA, chA = res['A']; stC, chC = res['C']
dg_in  = stA - (A_PRE - chA)          # A_now = A_pre - churnA + dg_in
dg_out = C_PRE - stC - chC            # C_pre = stayC + churnC + dg_out
print(f"  A: pre={A_PRE} churn={chA} ({chA/A_PRE*100:.2f}%) dg_in={dg_in}")
print(f"  C: pre={C_PRE} churn={chC} ({chC/C_PRE*100:.2f}%) dg_out={dg_out} ({dg_out/C_PRE*100:.2f}%)")
print(f"  consistency: dg_in({dg_in}) vs dg_out({dg_out}) vs dash 139")

# wave 1st-bill cohort [335,342): should be ~all churned this week; later trickle status
for lo,hi,lbl in [(335,342,'1stbill-this-wk'),(342,349,'1stbill-next-wk'),(349,371,'later-trickle')]:
    r = nm.query(f"""SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
      WHERE start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} GROUP BY status""")
    d = {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']}
    print(f"  cohort[{lo},{hi}) {lbl}: {d}")

# total churn decomposition this week
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>{E0} AND end_day<={E1}")['rows'][0]['n']
r_old = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>{E0} AND end_day<={E1} AND start_day<330")['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"\nTotal cancels this wk: {r} (old-core {r_old}, tail {r-r_old}) vs dash 862")

# New subs this week by group/plan
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id g, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(s.effective_price) p FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.start_day>={E0+1} AND s.start_day<={E1} GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC""")
print("\nNew subs d365-371 by group/plan:")
tot = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['g']} {row['plan']}: n={row['n']} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f}")
    tot += row['n']
print(f"  total={tot} vs dash 527")

# Book snapshot + durable split (start<337 = next forecast cutoff)
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("\nBook:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<337 GROUP BY plan")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  durable<337 plan {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:,} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f} cycle=${row['tot']:,.0f}")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day>=337")['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"  tail (start>=337): {r}")

import novamind_api as nm

# 1. New SUBSCRIBED this week by group/plan
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(s.effective_price) p FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.start_day>364 AND s.start_day<=371 AND s.status='subscribed'
  GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC""")
print("New SUBSCRIBED d365-371 by group/plan:")
tot=0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['g']} {row['plan']}: n={row['n']} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f}")
    tot+=row['n']
print(f"  total={tot} (dash 527)")

# 2. A-plan old-core churn THIS WEEK by group
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>364 AND s.end_day<=371 AND s.start_day<330 AND s.plan='A'
  GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC""")
print("\nA old-core churn this week by group:")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['g']}: {row['n']}")

# 3. A old-core book composition by group (remaining subscribed)
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n, AVG(s.effective_price) p FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day<330 AND s.plan='A'
  GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC""")
print("\nA old-core book (subscribed, start<330) by group:")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['g']}: n={row['n']} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f}")

# 4. C old-core churn this week by group (for context)
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>364 AND s.end_day<=371 AND s.start_day<330 AND s.plan='C'
  GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 8""")
print("\nC old-core churn this week by group (top8):")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['g']}: {row['n']}")

# 5. Leads by day this week (when did surge start?)
r = nm.query("""SELECT start_day d, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
  WHERE start_day>360 AND start_day<=371 GROUP BY start_day ORDER BY d""")
print("\nLeads by day d361-371:")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  d{row['d']}: {row['n']}")

import novamind_api as nm

# 1. Social posts last 8 days — what happened d364-371?
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=8, limit=40)
print("== SOCIAL POSTS d364-371 ==")
rows = posts if isinstance(posts, list) else posts.get('posts', posts.get('rows', []))
for p in rows[:40]:
    d = p.get('day'); c = (p.get('content') or '')[:130]
    print(f"  d{d}: {c}")

# 2. Trickle conversion timing: subs by start_day d358-371, split S2 vs other
r = nm.query("""SELECT s.start_day d, CASE WHEN c.group_id='S2' THEN 'S2' ELSE 'other' END grp,
  COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.start_day>=358 AND s.start_day<=371 AND s.status='subscribed'
  GROUP BY s.start_day, grp ORDER BY d""")
print("\n== Subscribed-now by start_day (S2 vs other) d358-371 ==")
byday = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    byday.setdefault(row['d'], {})[row['grp']] = row['n']
for d in sorted(byday): print(f"  d{d}: {byday[d]}")

# 3. A old-core churned vs stayed: effective price distribution
r = nm.query("""SELECT CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 'churned' ELSE 'stayed' END st,
  COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) avg_p, MIN(effective_price) mn, MAX(effective_price) mx
  FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day<330 AND plan='A' AND billing_day_mod30 IN (5,6,7,8,9,10,11)
  AND (status='subscribed' OR (status='cancelled' AND end_day>364 AND end_day<=371))
  GROUP BY st""")
print("\n== A window slice: churned vs stayed eff price ==")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['st']}: n={row['n']} avg=${row['avg_p']:.2f} min=${row['mn']:.2f} max=${row['mx']:.2f}")

# eff price histogram of churned A
r = nm.query("""SELECT ROUND(effective_price) p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
  WHERE start_day<330 AND plan='A' AND status='cancelled' AND end_day>364 AND end_day<=371
  GROUP BY ROUND(effective_price) ORDER BY p""")
print("  churned A price histogram:", [(row['p'], row['n']) for row in r['rows']])
r = nm.query("""SELECT ROUND(effective_price) p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
  WHERE start_day<330 AND plan='A' AND status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN (5,6,7,8,9,10,11)
  GROUP BY ROUND(effective_price) ORDER BY p""")
print("  stayed  A price histogram:", [(row['p'], row['n']) for row in r['rows']])

# 4. Whole A book eff-price histogram (all windows) for forecast
r = nm.query("""SELECT ROUND(effective_price) p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
  WHERE start_day<330 AND plan='A' AND status='subscribed' GROUP BY ROUND(effective_price) ORDER BY p""")

import novamind_api as nm
CASH = 39_943.268  # $K actual d371
TODAY = 371        # d504 = k=19
# ---- Measure durable-core slices (start<330), A split by price bucket ----
slices = []
for k in range(1, 20):
    days = [(TODAY + 7*(k-1) + i + 1) % 30 for i in range(7)]
    bdm = "(" + ",".join(str(d) for d in days) + ")"
    a49 = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) s FROM subscriptions
      WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<330 AND plan='A' AND effective_price<60 AND billing_day_mod30 IN {bdm}""")['rows'][0]
    a79 = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) s FROM subscriptions
      WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<330 AND plan='A' AND effective_price>=60 AND billing_day_mod30 IN {bdm}""")['rows'][0]
    c = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) s FROM subscriptions
      WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<330 AND plan='C' AND billing_day_mod30 IN {bdm}""")['rows'][0]
    slices.append((a49['n'] or 0, (a49['s'] or 0)/1000.0, a79['n'] or 0, (a79['s'] or 0)/1000.0,
                   c['n'] or 0, (c['s'] or 0)/1000.0))
print("week: (A49_n, A49$K, A79_n, A79$K, C_n, C$K)")
for i,s in enumerate(slices): print(f"  wk+{i+1}: {s[0]:5d} {s[1]:6.1f} {s[2]:5d} {s[3]:6.1f} {s[4]:6d} {s[5]:8.1f}")

BOOK0 = dict(a49=5364, a79=2626, c=46445)
PER_COMP_DUR = 8.35e-3; PER_COMP_TRANS = 16.6e-3  # $K/sub/wk
PER_ADREV  = 1.0566e-3
FIXED = 42.0

def run(p49_purge, p49_base, p79_purge, p79_base, c_can, dg, S0, Sdec, Sfloor, label, creep=0.0):
    cash = CASH; marks = {}
    bA49, bA79, bC = BOOK0['a49'], BOOK0['a79'], BOOK0['c']
    inflow_q = [50.0, 55.0, 48.0, 527.0]  # transient cohorts in residence
    wk1 = None
    for k in range(1, 20):
        a49n, a49r, a79n, a79r, cn, cr = slices[k-1]
        nb = 1 if k<=4 else 2 if k<=8 else 3 if k<=12 else 4 if k<=17 else 5
        cck = min(c_can + creep*k, c_can+0.010); dgk = min(dg + creep*k, dg+0.010)
        paid = 0.0
        for b in range(nb):
            r49 = p49_purge if b==0 else p49_base
            r79 = p79_purge if b==0 else p79_base
            sc = 1.0 - cck - dgk
            paid = a49r*(1-r49) + a79r*(1-r79) + cr*sc + cn*dgk*0.079
            a49r *= (1-r49)
            a79r = a79r*(1-r79) + cn*dgk*0.079
            cr *= sc; cn *= sc
        # signup stream
        Sk = max(S0*(Sdec**(k-1)), Sfloor)
        inflow_n = Sk/0.1287
        # book tracker (weekly fractions)
        f = 1/4.286
        purge_on = k <= 4.3
        bA49 *= (1 - (p49_purge if purge_on else p49_base)*f)
        dg_in_w = bC*dgk*f
        bA79 = bA79*(1 - (p79_purge if purge_on else p79_base)*f) + dg_in_w
        bC *= (1 - (cck+dgk)*f)
        inflow_q.append(inflow_n); inflow_q.pop(0)
        T = sum(inflow_q)
        D = bA49 + bA79 + bC
        N = D + T
        adrev = N*PER_ADREV; compute = D*PER_COMP_DUR + T*PER_COMP_TRANS
        leadcost = inflow_n*0.00431
        net = paid + Sk + adrev - compute - FIXED - leadcost
        cash += net
        if k==1: wk1 = dict(paid=paid, S=Sk, adrev=adrev, compute=compute, net=net, N=N)
        if k in (1,4,12,19): marks[k] = cash
    print(f"{label}: 1wk(d378)={marks[1]:.0f} 4wk(d399)={marks[4]:.0f} 12wk(d455)={marks[12]:.0f} d504={marks[19]:.0f}")
    return marks, wk1

dn, _      = run(.40,.12, .16,.09, .040,.020, 40,.62,3.0, "DOWNSIDE ")
drift, _   = run(.34,.06, .11,.05, .035,.014, 58,.78,5.4, "DRIFT    ", creep=0.0004)
midhi, _   = run(.31,.05, .095,.04,.032,.012, 75,.84,7.0, "mid-hi   ")
